```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = F, message=F, warning=F, eval=T)

```

3) If the integration has been finalized, provide the UMAP for snATAC-seq data of ARC and PVH. (Fig1), and the percentage of each cell type in the region from the snATAC-seq data (Fig.1f,g). Right now, we have snRNA-seq data for Fig.1f,g.

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(magrittr)
library(Signac)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}

ARC_int <- readRDS("../20240206_SCENICplus/data_snRNA_snATAC_Leptin_20240123/seuOBJ_snRNA_snATAC_allSample_ARC_merge.rds")

ARC_int_sub <- readRDS("../20240206_SCENICplus/data_snRNA_snATAC_Leptin_20240123/seuOBJ_snRNA_snATAC_allSample_ARC_merge_subClust.rds")

PVH_int <- readRDS("../20240206_SCENICplus/data_snRNA_snATAC_Leptin_20240123/seuOBJ_snRNA_snATAC_allSample_PVH_merge.rds")

PVH_int_sub <- readRDS("../20240206_SCENICplus/data_snRNA_snATAC_Leptin_20240123/seuOBJ_snRNA_snATAC_allSample_PVH_merge_subClust.rds")

ARC <- readRDS("data_objects/seuATAC_allSample_ARC.rds")

PVH <- readRDS("data_objects/seuATAC_allSample_PVH.rds")
```

```{r}

ARC@reductions$lsi <- NULL
ARC@reductions$umap.atac <- NULL

ARC <- RunTFIDF(ARC)
ARC <- FindTopFeatures(ARC, min.cutoff = 'q0')
ARC <- RunSVD(ARC)
ARC <- RunUMAP(object = ARC, reduction = 'lsi', dims = 2:30)
ARC <- FindNeighbors(object = ARC, reduction = 'lsi', dims = 2:30)
ARC <- FindClusters(object = ARC, verbose = FALSE, algorithm = 3)
```

# ARC


## Full Dataset

UMAPs showing ATAC datasets. These grouped by the samples, basic clustering (based on the ATAC) and RNA clustering.


```{r ARC_ATAC_UMAPs, fig.width=10, fig.height=10, fig.path='figures/', dev=c('png', 'pdf')}
DimPlot(ARC, group.by = "group")
DimPlot(ARC, group.by = "seurat_clusters") + ggtitle("basic clustering")

```

```{r ARC_ATAC_UMAPs-3, fig.width=10, fig.height=10, fig.path='figures/', dev=c('png', 'pdf')}


ARC$RNA_clusters <- ARC_int$cluster[match(names(ARC$orig.ident), names(ARC_int$cluster))]

DimPlot(ARC, group.by = "RNA_clusters") + ggtitle("RNA clustering")

```

These are the proportions on the ATAc specific clusters.

```{r}
library(dplyr)

to_plot <- cbind(ARC$seurat_clusters, ARC$group)
colnames(to_plot) <- c("cluster", "group")
to_plot %>% as.data.frame() %>% dplyr::group_by(cluster, group) %>% summarise(n()) %>% ggplot(aes(y=`n()`, x=group, fill=cluster )) + geom_bar(position="fill", stat="identity")


```

## RNA subset

UMAPs showing ATAC datasets. These grouped by the samples, basic clustering (based on the ATAC) and RNA clustering.

The dataset has been subset based on how the RNA has been subset.

```{R}
ARC <- readRDS("data_objects/seuATAC_allSample_ARC.rds")
ARC@reductions$lsi <- NULL
ARC@reductions$umap.atac <- NULL
ARC$RNA_clusters <- ARC_int$cluster[match(names(ARC$orig.ident), names(ARC_int$cluster))]

ARC_sub <- subset(ARC, subset = RNA_clusters %in% names(table(ARC_int_sub$cluster)))

```

```{r}

ARC_sub <- RunTFIDF(ARC_sub)
ARC_sub <- FindTopFeatures(ARC_sub, min.cutoff = 'q0')
ARC_sub <- RunSVD(ARC_sub)
ARC_sub <- RunUMAP(object = ARC_sub, reduction = 'lsi', dims = 2:30)
ARC_sub <- FindNeighbors(object = ARC_sub, reduction = 'lsi', dims = 2:30)
ARC_sub <- FindClusters(object = ARC_sub, verbose = FALSE, algorithm = 3)

```

```{r ARC_sub_ATAC_UMAPs, fig.width=10, fig.height=10, fig.path='figures/', dev=c('png', 'pdf')}

DimPlot(ARC_sub, group.by = "group")
DimPlot(ARC_sub, group.by = "seurat_clusters") + ggtitle("basic clustering")
DimPlot(ARC_sub, group.by = "RNA_clusters") + ggtitle("RNA clustering")
```

These are the proportions on the ATAC specific clusters.

```{r}
library(dplyr)

to_plot <- cbind(ARC_sub$seurat_clusters, ARC$group)
colnames(to_plot) <- c("cluster", "group")
to_plot %>% as.data.frame() %>% dplyr::group_by(cluster, group) %>% summarise(n()) %>% ggplot(aes(y=`n()`, x=group, fill=cluster )) + geom_bar(position="fill", stat="identity")


```

## RNA subset
